our_takes.our-take: UOB EVOL is great for lifestyle and travel users who prefer no-fee cards, regularly use options like Apple Pay or Samsung Pay, offering 10% cashback on online and mobile contactless spend, plus for a limited time only enjoy up to 1% cashback on eligible overseas FX transactions. Enjoy 0% FX fees on overseas transaction. To maximize value, spend at least S$800 monthly; otherwise, the cashback drops to 0.3%. Note the S$100 cashback cap split across online/mobile (S$30), selected gym, telco, streaming spend (S$20), and other spend (S$30), overseas FX spend till 31 Dec 2026 (S$20). Enjoy no annual fees on your card effective 1 July 2026.
our_takes.good-for:
Ideal for digital natives who want cashback on online and mobile contactless payments.
Travellers who are looking to maximise their travel spending with up to 1% cashback on overseas transactions
Great for those who appreciate no annual fees by hitting minimum spend of at least 3 transactions monthly.
Suited for individuals seeking rewards on overseas purchases made in foreign currencies.
our_takes.things-to-note:
Missing minimum monthly spend leads to reduced cashback, costing you rewards on your UOB EVOL card.
Carrying balances incurs 27.8% annual interest; unpaid amounts quickly increase your debt.
Late payments incur a S$100 fee per month, escalating costs if not paid on time.
